answer.answer: No specific aggregated dataset of paired same-method Mediterranean ocean-water microplastic samples within 50 km and one year exists in the literature to compute a reliable median factor. Reported Mediterranean surface water concentrations vary by orders of magnitude across studies even with similar methods, driven largely by differing sampling/extraction protocols rather than true spatial-temporal variability, so no single defensible number can be given.
